description: This file defines the InvadersDashlet class, a custom dashlet for the SuiteCRM platform. It extends the base Dashlet class and includes methods for rendering the dashlet, its script, options, and saving text via AJAX.

classes.name: InvadersDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashboard widget for SuiteCRM that displays an invaders game, with configurable height and text saving feature.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, loads language strings, sets default height and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet content, including Smarty template.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript associated with the dashlet, rendered via Smarty template.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays configuration options form for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves user input from configuration form, sanitizing height input.

methods.name: saveText
methods.description: Saves user-entered text via AJAX call; outputs JSON-encoded result.
